name: Microsoft Project Osmium

timeline.event: Land clearing begins on the north part of the site
Building 1 and 1st building on the site are operational. Foundation work begins on Building 2
Building 2 is operational. Estimated based on Microsoft H100 count 2023

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Microsoft Project Osmium: current power 190 MW; owner Microsoft.

explain: Microsoft Project Osmium is an operating AI data center in Cumming, IA, owned by microsoft. Epoch AI estimates it draws 190 MW today and 228 MW when finished.
